resources.string: Set up a profile to estimate maintenance calories.
Current maintenance estimate: %1$d %2$s/day. %3$d of %4$d days logged. Missing days excluded; partial diaries can overestimate deficit. Positive bars: deficit. Negative bars: surplus.
Weight comparison needs at least two days with weigh-ins in each of the opening and closing windows.

Opening average: %1$s %3$s (%4$d days). Closing average: %2$s %3$s (%5$d days). Daily means, up to seven days at each end of the period; shorter periods use separate half-windows. Negative loss means weight gain.
Current estimated maintenance: %1$d %2$s/day. %3$d of %4$d days have food records. Missing days are excluded; partial diaries can overestimate deficit. Negative deficit means surplus.
At least two weigh-ins in this period are needed to compare weight change.
Weight comparison: %1$s to %2$s. Negative loss means weight gain. Energy and weight use separate scales.
